body:
Sub-tasks (approved plan):

1. Routing: a server-only `/channels/<serverId>` URL routes to `server_channel` when a channel is rendered, else `unknown` (standard)
2. `serverId`/`channelId` extras; `channelId` is derived from the current channel link when the URL lacks it (standard)
3. Tighten the current-channel match to an exact comparison after normalisation (light)
4. `open_server` workflow tolerates server-only URLs (standard)
5. Manifests 1.4.1 / top-level 7, notes, CHANGELOG, re-sign (light)
6. Live verification via a custom shadow formatter, read-only (light)
7. Final verification (light)
